metadata.title: Why Research Death Records First + Ancestry Updates
metadata.author: Genealogy TV
metadata.shortDescription:
Learn why you should research death records first when researching your family history, plus Ancestry August 2019 updates regarding two new holocaust records sets from Ancestry.com.

*** SHOW NOTES ***

More about death records in general go to FamilySearch Wiki
